Global Options:
 -FromMsBuild         :  Format messages for msbuild
 -SuppressSDKWarnings :  Missing SDKs error verbosity level will be reduced from warning to log
 -Progress            :  Write progress messages in a format that can be parsed by other programs
 -NoMutex             :  Allow more than one instance of the program to run at once
 -WaitMutex           :  Wait for another instance to finish and then start, rather than aborting immediately
 -RemoteIni           :  Remote tool ini directory
 -Mode=               :  Tool mode to select. Default tool mode is 'Build'
 -Clean               :  Clean build products. Equivalent to -Mode=Clean
 -ProjectFiles        :  Generate project files based on IDE preference. Equivalent to -Mode=GenerateProjectFiles
 -ProjectFileFormat=  :  Generate project files in specified format. May be used multiple times.
 -Makefile            :  Generate Makefile
 -CMakefile           :  Generate project files for CMake
 -QMakefile           :  Generate project files for QMake
 -KDevelopfile        :  Generate project files for KDevelop
 -CodeliteFiles       :  Generate project files for Codelite
 -XCodeProjectFiles   :  Generate project files for XCode
 -EddieProjectFiles   :  Generate project files for Eddie
 -VSCode              :  Generate project files for Visual Studio Code
 -VSMac               :  Generate project files for Visual Studio Mac
 -CLion               :  Generate project files for CLion
 -Rider               :  Generate project files for Rider
 -AndroidStudio       :  Generate project files for Android Studio
 -TelemetryProvider   :  List of ini providers for telemetry
 -Session             :  Session identifier for this run of UBT, if unset defaults to a random Guid
 -Help                :  Display this help.
 -Verbose             :  Increase output verbosity
 -VeryVerbose         :  Increase output verbosity more
 -Log                 :  Specify a log file location instead of the default Engine/Programs/UnrealBuildTool/Log.txt
 -TraceWrites         :  Trace writes requested to the specified file
 -Timestamps          :  Include timestamps in the log

Available Tool Modes:
 AggregateClangTimingInfo  : Aggregates clang timing information files together into one monolithic breakdown file.
 AggregateParsedTimingInfo : Aggregates parsed Visual C++ timing information files together into one monolithic breakdown file.
 Build                     : Builds a target
 Clean                     : Cleans build products and intermediates for the target. This deletes files which are named consistently with the target being built (e.g. UnrealEditor-Foo-Win64-Debug.dll) rather than an actual record of previous build products.
 Deploy                    : Invokes the deployment handler for a target.
 Execute                   : Builds a target
 FixIncludePaths           : Fixes the include paths found in a header and source file
 GenerateClangDatabase     : Generate a clang compile_commands file for a target
 GenerateProjectFiles      : Generates project files for one or more projects
 InlineGeneratedCpps       : Generate a clang compile_commands file for a target
 IWYU                      : Profiles different unity sizes and prints out the different size and its timings
 JsonExport                : Exports a target as a JSON file
 ParseMsvcTimingInfo       : Parses an MSVC timing info file generated from cl-filter to turn it into a form that can be used by other tooling. This is implemented as a separate mode to allow it to be done as part of the action graph.
 PrintBuildGraphInfo       : Generate a clang compile_commands file for a target
 ProfileUnitySizes         : Profiles different unity sizes and prints out the different size and its timings
 Query                     : Summary unavailable
 QueryTargets              : Queries information about the targets supported by a project
 SetupPlatforms            : Register all platforms (and in the process, configure all autosdks)
 Test                      : Builds low level tests on one or more targets.
 ValidatePlatforms         : Validates the various platforms to determine if they are ready for building
 WriteDocumentation        : Generates documentation from reflection data
 WriteMetadata             : Writes all metadata files at the end of a build (receipts, version files, etc...). This is implemented as a separate mode to allow it to be done as part of the action graph.
 ApplePostBuildSync        : Summary unavailable
 PVSGather                 : Special mode for gathering all the messages into a single output file
 GDKGameConfigGenerator    : ToolMode to create a MicrosoftGame.config for a single executable pair
 Analyze                   : Outputs information about the given target, including a module dependecy graph (in .gefx format and list of module references)
 ClRepro                   : Summary unavailable
 PipInstall                : Identifies plugins with python requirements and attempts to install all dependencies using pip.
 ReportBuildResults        : Summary unavailable
 UnrealHeaderTool          : Invoke UHT
